review: Independent Codex review of the Range Bouncers preregistered historical experiment
independence: The reviewer did not write the strategy, simulation or report. Only this audit receipt was added by the reviewer.
verdict: Accepted for reporting. Neither target meets the preregistered sample floor. Historical target-hit rates do not establish persistence.
methods: Checked every monthly ISIN against the point-in-time membership intervals and every raw daily signal against the contemporary tradable constituents. Matched month-end labels without using future months. The difference of 15 stock-months is exhaustively attributable to documented pre-listing placeholders.

Joined two overlapping contemporary exchange price panels 160 sessions apart. Independently recomputed 500-session geometry and 250-session traversal counts at the first month-end in each test year for stocks with verifiable overlap. Independently reconstructed simple gross shareholder returns with dated cash reinvestment. Compared daily RSI, ATR and range values using scalar recursions.

Checked every ledger fill against raw NSE-based opening or scheduled closing marks with 5bp slippage and independently recalculated the fee schedule, including once-per-ISIN/day DP charges in the funded portfolio. Reconstructed funded cash and exposure on every scheduled session. Checked equal risk and stop bounds on ordinary independent orders.

Replayed first stop, fixed target and time conditions directly from raw closes for uncomplicated completed positions. Reconciled all funded and independent dividend receipts to signed ex-date cash and pre-opening holdings. Independently parsed simple cash terms during ordinary holding periods. Traced selected GAIL and L&T orders to the official allocation, temporary credit and listing dates, restricted units, fractional cash and first-close fallback.

Counted target hits and full-horizon observable fills per year and cohort directly from first exit-due events and the session calendar. Recomputed the sample floor, profit-factor eligibility, mean-R eligibility and positive-window denominator for every book. No eligible 20-trade sample existed from which to estimate a qualifying bootstrap interval.

Independently checked the original r2 file hash, the frozen A126 tag commit, and radar report --since-freeze. The frozen report identified the verified tag, zero forward observations and a paper-only account.

findings_and_resolution.finding: NSE misspelled the October 2020 Nestlé dividend; an independently computed January 2021 shareholder return disagreed with the first selector.
findings_and_resolution.resolution: Audited archive spellings, cross-checked dated issue aliases and ambiguous notices. Confirmed the repaired January return of 11.2035218561% and reran the independent checks against the final data manifest. Relevant commits b9d4bab, c6086b1 and ee34ddf.

findings_and_resolution.finding: The original publisher could read fresh selector or coverage files without verifying all three against the replay receipt.
findings_and_resolution.resolution: c083774 binds these products and the official market identity to the registered replay. Verified the negative regression and final journal fingerprints.

findings_and_resolution.finding: Initial funded 2022 replay ended at GAIL bonus issue. L&T bonus terms also censored 2017 comparison calls.
findings_and_resolution.resolution: Final study uses NSE CML53755/FAOP53495 for GAIL, and CML35388 with the issuer record-date notice for L&T. Validated both independently. All 60 book-windows reached their scheduled end. The 56e3cf7b run is superseded.

remaining_limitations: The annual action extracts lack reliable event broadcast timestamps. Effective-date observation can be checked, but later notice revisions cannot always be distinguished from the original vintage.
Three remaining quarantined closes (INDIANB, PNB, ZEEL) censor affected independent comparison calls. No uncertain price path is scored a loss.

Repeated observations in the same stock and on adjacent days are dependent. Three windows passed the entry-data gate in both persistence cohorts. The direction of the descriptive difference changes with the coverage selection.
